name: outgoing-ring-phase-crossfades
description: A rAF trace across the waiting-to-receiving crossing, driven directly through window.atriumTabLoading/atriumLoadPhase rather than a real network load, so the crossing lands at a known moment instead of whenever a fixture page happens to finish. A still capture cannot see a one-frame opacity drop, so every frame's .brdr::before/::after opacity is logged for the 1.5s around the push, and the script itself decides whether the outgoing (::after) value passed through an intermediate frame or jumped straight to 0.

actions.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.tabrow.sel[data-tab-id]') || document.querySelector('.tabrow[data-tab-id]'); if (!row) { return 'no row'; } window.__ringTabId = row.dataset.tabId; return window.__ringTabId; })()
actions.note: the id atriumLoadPhase gates on: findActiveTab must agree, so the selected row is picked first
ringpulse (1.3s) is well into its cycle, matching the description's own trace, which caught phase 1 mid-pulse at before=0 after=0.45

actions.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.tabrow[data-tab-id="' + window.__ringTabId + '"]'); if (!row) { return 'row gone'; } const b = row.querySelector('.brdr'); if (!b) { return 'no brdr'; } window.__crossLog = []; const t0 = performance.now(); const two = (v) => Number(v).toFixed(2); const tick = () => { const be = two(getComputedStyle(b, '::before').opacity); const af = two(getComputedStyle(b, '::after').opacity); const cls = [...row.classList].filter((c) => c !== 'tabrow' && c !== 'row').join('.'); window.__crossLog.push({t: performance.now() - t0, before: be, after: af, cls}); if (performance.now() - t0 < 1500) { requestAnimationFrame(tick); } }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); return 'armed'; })()
(window.__crossLog || []).map((r) => Math.round(r.t) + 'ms before=' + r.before + ' after=' + r.after + ' [' + r.cls + ']').join(' | ')
actions.note: THE MEASUREMENT: every frame's opacity either side of the phase push

actions.expression: (() => { const log = window.__crossLog || []; const receivingIdx = log.findIndex((r) => r.cls.includes('receiving')); if (receivingIdx < 1) { return 'no crossing seen'; } const preAfter = Number(log[receivingIdx - 1].after); const firstAfter = Number(log[receivingIdx].after); if (!(preAfter > 0.05)) { return 'nothing to fade from (' + preAfter + ')'; } if (firstAfter <= 0.02) { return 'jumped (0 intermediate frames)'; } let steps = 0; for (let i = receivingIdx + 1; i < log.length; i++) { const v = Number(log[i].after); if (v <= 0) { break; } if (v < firstAfter - 0.02) { steps++; } } return steps >= 1 ? 'faded' : 'jumped (' + steps + ' intermediate frames)'; })()
actions.note: The receiving class's own first sampled frame is the fade's real starting point, since the pulse may still be rising when the push lands - at least one frame strictly between that value and 0 means the .25s transition ran, and a first frame already at 0 means it snapped before the sampler could see it move

assertions.desc: The outgoing ::after opacity steps down over the transition rather than disappearing in one frame
